03 / INSPECT THE SOURCES

Matching customer experiences

How was this evidence selected?

First, filter to the exact product. Next, match the activity and rank by distance from your requested duration. Include reviews within one hour, regardless of sentiment. All eligible reviews are shown and counted; there is no hidden sample.

The one-hour cutoff is an explicit teaching assumption. Reviews outside it might still matter, so limited matches should prompt investigation rather than certainty.

No AI model is connected. Answers use transparent rules and templates. No personal data is collected or sent to a server.
